vetSays.line: 🛡️ Giuseppe, Judith, Kiara and Yara met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Giuseppe, Kiara, Yara are hurt.
🛡️ Giuseppe, Ruben, Mai, Kiara and Ethan met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 driven off. Giuseppe, Ruben, Mai, Ethan are hurt.
🛡️ Giuseppe, Ruben and Judith met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Giuseppe, Ruben, Judith are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Ruben, Judith and Mai met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off. Ruben is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ethan just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Judith, Mai, Kiara and Ethan met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Judith, Ethan are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ethan just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Mai, Kiara and Ethan met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Mai, Ethan are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

regDeaths.name: a raccoon with too many fingers, working at something
a drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer
a monitor lizard the size of a canoe, light sliding wrong off its back
